description.zh: 列表当前页号， 大于等于1。
description.en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

description.zh:
实体类型。取值：
- ip：ip
- process：进程
- file：文件
description.en:
The entity type. Valid values:
- ip: IP address
- process: process
- file: file

description.zh: 列表每页条数， 最大不超过100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Select the data management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
- cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
- ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside in regions outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.
